purpose: Measure short greedy decoding throughput for one exact 4-bit MLX model on the same M1 Pro using MLX GPU and CPU backends.

decoding.prompt: Explain how to implement gradient accumulation correctly when the last microbatch is smaller than the accumulation window. Give a concise answer.

hardware_gate.device: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory

primary_metric: Median generated tokens per second; descriptive local microbenchmark only.
interpretation_limit: One short prompt, one model, three repeats per backend, no inference quality comparison or statistical claim.
